slides: Welcome back. Before the advanced questions, one more move on the number line. Multiplying by a negative number.

slides.say: Times a positive number keeps a number on its side of zero. Times a negative number, it jumps to the other side, the mirror image. Three times negative one is negative three, and seven times negative one is negative seven.
And look at the order. Three is smaller than seven, but negative three is bigger than negative seven. Times a negative, the order flips.
One more. Two is smaller than five. Times negative two, they're negative four and negative ten. And negative four is the bigger one. The order flipped again.

You know this from inequalities. Multiply both sides by a negative, and the sign flips. It's the same move. Now the advanced questions. Try each one first, and then watch. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next video.
